description: A single-panel figure consisting of one rendered table (no plots, micrographs or schematics) that inventories the evaluation protocols of 11 microscopy datasets used for microstructure segmentation. The table has six column headers: "Type", "Name", "Material", "Resolution (pixels)", "#" and "Metrics". The first column groups datasets into three task types: "grain" (one dataset), "boundary" (four datasets) and "phase" (six datasets). Rows read: PI-1 / pure iron / 1024 × 1024 / 59 / ARI↑ under grain; SS / stainless steel / 1024 × 1024 / 44 / F1↑, HEA / high-entropy alloy / 1771 × 1061 / 38 / Recall, PI-2 / pure iron / 1280 × 960 / 12, LCS [11] / low carbon steel / 1360 × 600 / 16 under boundary; and NBS-1 [16] / Ni-based superalloy / 512 × 512 / 4 / IoU↑ F1↑, NBS-2 [16] / Ni-based superalloy / 512 × 512 / 5 / Recall, AZA [25] / AlZn alloy / 852 × 852 / 2, UHCS [11] / ultrahigh carbon steel / 645 × 475 / 5, DP590–1 / dual-phase steel / 512 × 512 / 23 and DP590–2 / dual-phase steel / 1024 × 768 / 21 under phase. The caption states these are 11 public and in-house microscopy datasets and that an upward arrow means a higher metric value indicates better segmentation; arrows are printed on ARI, F1 and IoU but not on Recall.

subfigures.description: A single table with columns Type, Name, Material, Resolution (pixels), # and Metrics, listing 11 microscopy datasets in three groups: grain (PI-1), boundary (SS, HEA, PI-2, LCS [11]) and phase (NBS-1 [16], NBS-2 [16], AZA [25], UHCS [11], DP590–1, DP590–2), with their pixel resolutions, image counts and segmentation metrics (ARI↑, F1↑, Recall, IoU↑, F1↑, Recall).

observations.observation: The figure is a rendered table with the column headers 'Type', 'Name', 'Material', 'Resolution (pixels)', '#', and 'Metrics'.

The 'Type' column defines three task categories: 'grain' (1 dataset), 'boundary' (4 datasets: SS, HEA, PI-2, LCS) and 'phase' (6 datasets: NBS-1, NBS-2, AZA, UHCS, DP590–1, DP590–2), totalling 11 datasets.
Row 'PI-1' is typed 'grain', material 'pure iron', resolution 1024 × 1024, '#' = 59, metric 'ARI↑'.

Boundary rows: 'SS' stainless steel 1024 × 1024, # = 44, F1↑; 'HEA' high-entropy alloy 1771 × 1061, # = 38, Recall; 'PI-2' pure iron 1280 × 960, # = 12; 'LCS [11]' low carbon steel 1360 × 600, # = 16.

Phase rows: 'NBS-1 [16]' Ni-based superalloy 512 × 512, # = 4, IoU↑ F1↑; 'NBS-2 [16]' Ni-based superalloy 512 × 512, # = 5, Recall; 'AZA [25]' AlZn alloy 852 × 852, # = 2; 'UHCS [11]' ultrahigh carbon steel 645 × 475, # = 5; 'DP590–1' dual-phase steel 512 × 512, # = 23; 'DP590–2' dual-phase steel 1024 × 768, # = 21.
The upward arrow (↑) is printed only on 'ARI', 'F1' and 'IoU' in the Metrics column; the 'Recall' entries carry no arrow.
The caption states that an upward arrow indicates that a higher value of the metric corresponds to better segmentation performance.
The caption states the table covers 11 public and in-house microscopy datasets, although the caption does not define the meaning of the '#' column.
Dataset resolutions range from 512 × 512 (NBS-1, NBS-2, DP590–1) to 1771 × 1061 (HEA).
Reference tags printed in the Name column are [11] on LCS and UHCS, [16] on NBS-1 and NBS-2, and [25] on AZA, marking the datasets taken from prior work.
Material systems listed are pure iron, stainless steel, high-entropy alloy, low carbon steel, Ni-based superalloy, AlZn alloy, ultrahigh carbon steel and dual-phase steel.
The '#' column values (59, 44, 38, 12, 16, 4, 5, 2, 5, 23, 21) sum to 229; the table header does not state the unit of this column.

measured_quantities: dataset size/count ('#' column, unit not stated)
